title: Tola runs Chinese all-comers' record in Beijing (short item in the Amsterdam report)

story.M: Tamirat Tola won in 2:03:10, the fastest marathon ever run in China; the first three all beat the previous record.

performances.name: Tamirat TOLA
performances.note: The Olympic champion ran 2:03:10, the fastest marathon ever run in China, taking almost four minutes off the Beijing course record.
